QuestInfo.name: Grendel the Head Librarian
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've regained control, return to the Magic Library.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you've regained control, return to the Magic Library.
QuestInfo.2: Grendel the Really Old got back. Finally, someone who knows what he's doing!

0.1: What did you call me?\r\n#L0##bHas age robbed you of your hearing as well as your senses?#l\n#k
0.3: The things I have to deal with in my old age... Give me just a moment.

no.0: Then leave. You're not ready to face the likes of me.

0.2: So much for doing this the nice way. A pity. I'd hoped to study your Dark aura more closely.\r\n#L0##bYou can sense my darkness? Perhaps you can help! I lost control and sent your student to...another place. For his sake, stay your hand!#l\n#k
0.0: That's close enough. I do hope you aren't here to cause trouble.\r\n#L0##bOut of my way, old fool. I have business here.#l\n#k
